_comment: Motor Town: Behind The Wheel dedicated server under GE-Proton. Pterodactyl PTDL_v2 format; imports into Calagopus, Pterodactyl and Pelican.
name: Motor Town: Behind The Wheel
author: motor-town-server
description: Motor Town: Behind The Wheel dedicated server (Windows build) running under GE-Proton's Wine. Needs a Steam account that owns Motor Town. Uses about 7 GB of memory once the world is loaded, so give it at least 10 GB. Players connect through Steam networking, so the server shows up in the game's server list without extra ports.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Motor Town: nothing to download here. The server files come from Steam with
# an account that owns the game, and Steam Guard needs the live console, so the
# first start downloads them (about 2 GB) instead.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
echo "Motor Town server: the first start downloads the game files with steamcmd."
echo "If Steam asks for a Steam Guard code, type it into the console,"
echo "or put a fresh code in the Steam Guard Code variable and restart."

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Steam account that owns Motor Town. The server files can't be downloaded anonymously.

variables.name: Steam Password
variables.description: Only needed until the first successful login; steamcmd then keeps a login token in the server folder and you can clear this.

variables.name: Steam Guard Code
variables.description: Optional. A fresh Steam Guard code for the next login. You can also type the code into the console when steamcmd asks for it.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with steamcmd on every start (1) or not (0).

variables.name: Server Message
variables.description: Shown to players after they connect.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password to join. Leave empty for a public server.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players (1-100; 20 is recommended for average systems).

variables.name: Steam Beta Branch
variables.description: The dedicated server is published on Steam's beta branch.

variables.name: Steam Beta Password
variables.description: Code that unlocks the beta branch, published by the developer.
